Ari (prod): Follow-up from the all-hands security Q&A: customers want a tiny FAQ for auditors sales can use. Key asks: one-line BYOK vs BYOQ, how to verify exported audit bundles, and what Private preserves in logs. Can security/compliance confirm concise lines?

Jordan (security): BYOK = you manage keys in a cloud KMS (we integrate; we don't see plaintext). BYOQ = you maintain key material in your HSM; we record HSM attestation included in exports.

Tara (compliance): Verification line for auditors: we provide daily signed export bundles with a manifest (SHA256 checksums) and a detached signature so auditors can verify integrity and timestamp.

Mina (eng): Quick verification commands to paste into docs: `sha256sum events.ndjson.gz` then compare to manifest; verify signature with `gpg --verify signature.asc manifest`.

Jordan (security): Private/VPC note: control-plane events (auth, config, routing) are logged and included in bundles; data-plane inference payloads are not stored unless customer opts into full-log export.

Docs Bot: Action items: Jordan/Tara to provide one-sentence lines for sales by EOD; Mina to add verification commands and example filename pattern to docs.

Ari (prod): Perfect 10. I'll slot the lines into the sales one-pager once posted. :thumbsup:
